units.source_text: 悬挂在御旅所的虔诚者敬献的灯笼，以及参拜者供奉的蜡烛，把神前照得一片通明。

en.t: The lanterns offered by the devout and hung at the otabisho, together with the candles presented by worshippers, brightly illuminated the area before the shrine.

units.source_text: 姑娘的眼睛本来已经泪花花的了，所以灯光投在姑娘的脸上，反而显得更加闪闪有光。

en.t: The girl's eyes were already wet with tears, so when the lamplight fell on her face, they seemed to shine all the more.
